# 💥 OCEMC.NET

🔥 A Brand New OCE Network for the Australian & New Zealand Commuinty

## ⚙️ Gamemodes We Have!

- **⛏️ GenPvP** | The Biggest Gen PvP Server in the OCE Region based of Minehut
- **⚔️ OceSMP** | A Unquie Public SMP based of 2b2t & Modern SMP's with Easier Grinding!
- **💥 Practice** | Create Clans, Grind the Leaderboards & Practice with the Spear _Coming Soon_
## 🔥 Why OCEMC?

- 🙂 Friendly community with active players & staff
- 🛠️ Fun PvP gamemodes made for the commuinty
- 👀 We listen to the commuinty doing polls for changes when needed!

- ⚙️ **Java IP: ocemc.net**
- 🔉 **Our Discord: https://discord.ocemc.net/**
